channel.title: Road Wars
channel.desc: New Jersey police pull over a city councilman; a semi barrels through a busy intersection in Washington; a motorist in Utah is challenged by a driver who appears to be brake checking; a family loading their car beside a busy road in Thailand ends up in the crosshairs of an oncoming vehicle; an SUV in Chicago following closely behind another vehicle gets an unpleasant surprise.
